name: vwap_mean_reversion_v14
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index reaches a 2.2-sigma deviation below session VWAP while 1-minute EMA-smoothed volume is 1.8x the 20-minute volume baseline, multiple VWAP-benchmarked institutional programs have triggered simultaneously — not a single-algo spike but a convergent forced-sell cascade sustained across at least 60 seconds. The EMA-smoothed volume ratio (vs single raw bar in other variants) confirms the selling is a persistent wave, not a data artifact. The entry fires only on the first bar where the z-score begins improving (zscore_delta > 0), marking the precise inflection where passive market-makers with resting buy orders sitting 0.3-0.5% below VWAP have absorbed the cascade's tail. At this moment on NIFTY, the sell-side order queue is depleted and the next 30-90 seconds produce a 12-20 spot point snap-back as the book replenishes from the bid side.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each session_date
indicators.purpose: Cumulative session VWAP — the benchmark that all VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms on NIFTY track intraday. No scaling: cumulative measure resets at session open, not a windowed indicator.

indicators.name: vwap_stddev_420
indicators.purpose: 35-minute rolling standard deviation of close for z-score normalization. Original used STDDEV(50) at 5-min bars = 250-minute window; blind 12x scaling gives 3000 bars (too long, spans multiple sessions). Instead: 420 bars (35 min) reflects mid-session intraday volatility regime without being distorted by the open's wide range. Shorter than v13's 720-bar (60-min) because v14 enters at inflection — the stddev must reflect CURRENT regime, not full-morning history.

indicators.name: vwap_zscore
indicators.purpose: Deviation from VWAP normalized by 35-min session volatility. Threshold -2.2 preserves the original's selectivity. Floor of 0.5 prevents division instability in ultra-low-vol sessions. Sits between v12's -1.5 (shallow) and v13's -2.4 (very deep) — but the inflection trigger (zscore_delta > 0) adds entry precision that compensates for the moderate depth.

indicators.name: vol_ema_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute EMA-smoothed volume (12 bars at 5s). Original uses raw current-bar volume; at 5s resolution single bars are very noisy. EMA over 12 bars produces a smoothed 60-second volume level — if this is elevated, selling has been sustained at high pace for ~60 seconds, not just a one-bar artifact.

indicators.name: vol_ema_240
indicators.purpose: 20-minute EMA-smoothed volume baseline (240 bars at 5s). Original uses SMA(volume, 20) at 5-min bars = 100-min baseline. Compressed to 20 min (240 bars) because at 5s frequency a 100-min window spans most of a session and underweights recent pace. EMA (vs SMA in v12/v13) naturally downweights older data, tracking current session pace while being robust to the open's volume spike.

indicators.name: smoothed_rel_vol
indicators.purpose: 1-min EMA volume relative to 20-min EMA baseline. Original threshold 1.8. Requiring SMOOTHED ratio > 1.8 is stricter than raw rel_volume > 1.3 used in v12/v13 — it filters out single-bar spikes, selecting only events where selling has been elevated for a full minute. This is the primary volume differentiator from all other VWAP variants.

indicators.name: zscore_delta
indicators.purpose: One-bar (5-second) change in z-score. The KEY entry differentiator: positive zscore_delta at extreme negative z-score means the deviation is shrinking — the sell wave is decelerating and reverting. No other converted VWAP variant uses this signal. Entry fires on the FIRST bar of z-score improvement, catching the precise inflection before the bulk of the reversion runs. At 5-second resolution this inflection is observable one bar before a 1-min chart would confirm a reversal.

conditions: vwap_zscore < -zscore_threshold (default -2.2): price deeply below VWAP by 2.2 session-std units
smoothed_rel_vol > vol_ratio_threshold (default 1.8): 1-min EMA volume is 1.8x the 20-min EMA baseline — sell cascade has been sustained ~60 seconds
zscore_delta > 0: z-score is IMPROVING (sell wave decelerating) — this is the inflection trigger
vix_close < vix_max (default 28.0): avoid extreme volatility regimes where VWAP reversion takes 5+ minutes
buy_ce.confirmation: Three-factor entry: magnitude (deep z-score) + sustained selling (smoothed ratio > 1.8 confirming 60s of elevated volume) + inflection (z-score just turned toward VWAP). All three must be simultaneous on the entry bar.

conditions: zscore_delta < 0: z-score is declining from extreme high (run-up decelerating at the inflection)
buy_pe.confirmation: Symmetric fade: sustained high-volume run above VWAP with first downward z-score tick marks where aggressive buyers have absorbed remaining supply.

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points = ~10 NIFTY spot points adverse from the inflection entry. We enter at the first bar of z-score improvement after a -2.2 sigma event; if the next bars push NIFTY another 10 spot points lower, the deceleration was a false pause and the cascade is resuming. Slightly wider than v12's 4 pts because the inflection entry has higher per-trade confidence (higher volume requirement + directional filter) and deserves a wider stop before invalidation. At 2-minute NIFTY typical moves of 5-10 option pts, a 5-pt stop allows roughly 90 seconds for the thesis to play out.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = ~14 NIFTY spot points. At a confirmed inflection after a -2.2 sigma event with sustained volume, NIFTY typically recovers 14-20 spot points within 30-90 seconds (ATM delta ~0.5 → 7-10 option pts). Targeting 7 pts captures the lower bound of this range — ensures exit before a stall midway — while giving 1:1.4 R:R. Higher-quality entry (inflection + smoothed volume) compensates for the tighter ratio versus deeper-deviation strategies.

filters.vix_filter: vix_close < 28.0 — above 28, institutional VWAP programs widen tolerance and NIFTY reversion takes 5+ minutes not 30-90 seconds; ATM option gamma also too unstable for stop calibration
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:20 IST — skip first 5 min (VWAP needs accumulation), flatten 10 min before close
filters.volume_filter: smoothed_rel_vol > 1.8 — stricter than v12/v13's 1.3; requires sustained 60-second elevated volume vs recent 20-min baseline
filters.trend_filter: zscore_delta > 0 at entry functions as inflection filter, obviating a separate trend filter
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — EMA-smoothed volume signal is robust to single-bar noise; inflection entry improves signal quality but reduces trade frequency to ~1-4/day

adaptation_notes: Original trades nifty200 stocks on 5-min bars with 5-15 bar holds (25-75 min). Three key adaptations to 5s index options: (1) Universe → NIFTY index: the panic-sell + VWAP-benchmark thesis maps to stop-loss cascade + institutional VWAP algorithms on the index itself. (2) Volume smoothing: original uses raw_volume / SMA(20) = 100-min baseline. Converted to EMA(12) / EMA(240) = 1-min smoothed vs 20-min smoothed — eliminates single-bar false spikes that plague 5-second NIFTY volume data without sacrificing burst detection. (3) Inflection entry: original enters as soon as z-score and volume conditions are met (holding all day for reversion); at 5s we add zscore_delta > 0 to detect the sell wave's precise turn, shifting the hold from 25-75 minutes to 30-90 seconds. DIFFERENTIATED from all other VWAP variants: v12 = flush-ongoing (bar_return < 0), v13 = 2-bar persistence filter, v18 = deviation momentum (rate of change), v19 = range contraction microstructure. v14 uniquely combines EMA-smoothed volume ratio + inflection entry — no other variant does both.
weaknesses: Inflection trigger delays entry by at least 1 bar — fast NIFTY snap-backs may run 2-4 option pts before signal fires, compressing effective target capture
EMA(12) has 1-minute lag — the smoothed volume elevated signal arrives after the raw spike, reducing trade count vs single-bar variants
420-bar warmup means no signals in first 35 minutes of session (09:15-09:50 IST effectively dead)
High smoothed vol threshold (1.8x) makes this a low-frequency strategy — potentially 1-3 trades/day in typical sessions
NIFTY index volume at 5s can include futures roll spikes near expiry that distort vol_ema_240 baseline
